displayIdentity.body: Priscilla and Aquila instruct Apollos. Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures. for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
